welcomeSub: Start a server, open its console or pick up where you left off.
manageServers: Select a server to manage its world, players and backups.
noServersSub: Create a server or import one you already have.
noActivity: Your server actions will appear here.
localNoteSub: No cloud account. Installed servers also work offline.
mock: Demo mode — servers, players and metrics are simulated.
desktopOnly: Open MineDock desktop to manage servers. The browser development UI is available with pnpm dev:mock.
createSub: A few settings and your server is ready for players.
paperHelp: Fast, with plugin support. Recommended for playing with friends.
vanillaHelp: The official Minecraft experience, without plugins or mods.
name: Server name
stableOnly: Official releases. Only stable Paper builds are installed.
ramHelp: 4 GB is a useful starting point for a small Paper server. Larger worlds and modpacks may need more.
portHelp: Each server needs a unique port. MineDock checks availability.
onlineWarning: Disabling account verification allows impersonation. Keep it enabled on network-accessible servers.
automaticJava: Required Java installed automatically when needed
automaticRcon: RCON enabled with a protected secret
eulaAccept: I have read and accept the Minecraft EULA.
installHelp: Files come from Mojang, PaperMC and Eclipse Adoptium. Integrity is verified before installation.
consoleEmpty: Start the server to see its logs here.
noPlayersSub: Players appear after joining. Moderation commands use RCON.
backupSub: Local archives, verified with SHA-256. A safety copy precedes every restore.
confirmHelp: Type the exact name below to confirm.
restoreHelp: The server must be stopped. Current files will be replaced after a safety backup.
deleteServerHelp: The server is removed from the list. Its folder is preserved in MineDock’s local trash.
deleteFileHelp: A full server backup precedes file deletion.
scheduleSub: Tasks are persisted in SQLite. MineDock must remain open to execute them.
propertiesHelp: Stop the server before changing settings. A safety backup is created on every save.
worldHelp: Worlds are backed up with the whole server. Change the world folder name in settings to generate a new world on next start.
fileSub: Edit text files up to 2 MB. Stop the server before making changes.
marketplaceSub: Modrinth plugins compatible with your Paper version. Required dependencies install automatically.
vanillaPlugins: Vanilla does not support plugins. Create a Paper server to use the marketplace.
analyticsHelp: Java process measurements, retained for 7 days. CPU can exceed 100% across multiple cores.
noMetrics: Measurements appear after starting the server.
folderHelp: Changing the server folder affects future servers. Existing servers stay in place.
preventSleep: Prevent sleep while a server is running
preventSleepHelp: Temporary inhibition only. No permanent system setting changes.
runtimeHelp: Temurin installs within MineDock without changing your computer’s PATH.
credits: React · Electron · SQLite · Tailwind · Lucide · Adoptium
updatesNote: Application updates use verified publisher metadata. Windows and macOS packages currently have no OS signing certificate.
setupSub: Let’s prepare your computer for your worlds.
setupFinish: Everything is local. You stay in control.
javaAutoHelp: No Java? MineDock will download the right version for your first server.
setupPrivacy: Catalogs and downloads use the Internet. Your worlds and logs stay on your computer.
localAdmin: V1 uses your operating-system account. No remote admin panel is exposed.
activitySub: Local history of operations, errors and backups.
commandHelp: Up / down arrows: history. Sensitive commands use the management buttons.
restartWarning: Scheduled restarts announce a 10-second countdown to players.
localNetworkHelp: Share the network address only within your LAN. Never forward the RCON port to the Internet.
nativeHelp: Runs the official native Bedrock server without Java.
phpHelp: PocketMine uses its own PHP runtime. MineDock downloads the compatible runtime automatically.
modsHelp: A Java server with a mod loader and a managed mods folder.
operationsHelp: Review downloads, installations and recovery after interruption.
restartWarnings: Warnings before restart (seconds, separated by commas)
contentMarketplaceHelp: Compatible server plugins and mods. Review the version before installing; required dependencies install with it.
managedContentHelp: MineDock tracks these files. Updates require your choice and a stopped server.
uninstallContentHelp: Remove only the tracked binary. Configuration folders, plugin data and manually added files are preserved. A safety backup is created first.
manualContentHelp: Detected from the real folder. MineDock does not infer their versions or manage them automatically. Use the Files tab to edit them.
versionSelectionHelp: Select an exact version. Compatibility, dependencies, publication date and changelog come from the official provider.
changeContentHelp: Replace the managed binary with the selected version after creating a safety backup. Configuration and manual files are preserved.
rollbackContentHelp: Restore a saved binary after checking its hash and server compatibility. A safety backup is created first. Plugin data and configuration are preserved.
contentHistoryLimitHelp: Keep 1–20 previous binaries; default 5. Safety backups have separate retention.
crossplayHelp: Let Bedrock players join your Java server using the correct Geyser variant.
crossplayVerificationHelp: This status checks installed files and configuration. Start the server and test with a Bedrock client to validate connectivity. Internet access requires the UDP port to be reachable.
noSupportedGeyser: No currently supported Geyser version matches this server. Java 21 or newer is required. Fabric and NeoForge must match the current Geyser Minecraft target.
floodgateHelp: Floodgate permits authenticated Bedrock accounts to join without owning a Java account. MineDock keeps Java online-mode unchanged. Floodgate keys remain in the server folder.
crossplayDependenciesHelp: Required dependencies are installed with the selected components. Paper/Purpur may also require ViaVersion; Fabric may require Fabric API.
crossplayConfirmHelp: Install or update the selected components and write the Bedrock UDP/authentication configuration. A safety backup is created before preparing an atomic server-folder replacement.
importServerHelp: Review the detected engine, version and launch files. Stop the source server before importing. Existing worlds and manually installed content are preserved.
importDetected: Engine and version detected. Verify the values before continuing.
importUncertain: Some details could not be detected reliably. Correct the engine, version or launch file before importing.
copyImportedServerHelp: Recommended. Prepare a separate copy and keep the entire source folder unchanged.
originalImportedServerHelp: Manage this original folder. MineDock archives it before changing network/RCON settings. Removing its profile later retains the original files. Java servers need an already accepted EULA.
importEulaHelp: Consent is written only into a prepared copy. Managing an original folder requires its existing eula=true. Minecraft EULA: https://www.minecraft.net/eula
importServerConfirm: Import this server with the reviewed engine, version and network settings. The copy option preserves the entire source. Compatible runtimes may be downloaded automatically.
detachImportedServerHelp: Remove the MineDock profile. The original server folder is retained with its current configuration; a recovery copy is also kept in MineDock’s trash.
worldManagerHelp: Inspect, import and manage worlds with their associated dimensions. Stop the server before changing or exporting a world.
worldImportHelp: Review this world before importing. The original source is preserved, all dimensions are copied, and a safety backup is created. Importing does not select the world automatically.
worldModifyHelp: A safety backup is created before applying this change. Java dimensions are handled together. Deleting the active world requires selecting another world first.
worldNameHelp: Use letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. Do not use a Nether or End dimension suffix.
metadataUnavailable: Some world metadata could not be read. Files and sizes are available; unknown values are not inferred.
worldVersionWarning: The world was saved in a different Minecraft version. Verify compatibility before importing.
stopBeforeEditing: Stop the server before changing or exporting its worlds.
modpackImportHelp: Review the pinned Minecraft version, loader, downloads and overrides before creating a new server. Client-only files are excluded. Optional server files require selection. Minecraft EULA consent is requested in the creation wizard.
modpackProtectedHelp: Launcher files, EULA, network properties and unsupported paths do not replace MineDock-managed files. Shared overrides are applied first, then server overrides.
modpackPinnedHelp: Minecraft and the loader are pinned by the selected modpack manifest.
relativePathHelp: Path relative to the server folder, for example config/settings.yml.
fileActionHelp: Stop the server first. A safety backup is created before applying changes. Essential launch files and managed content are protected.
storageDetailsHelp: Scan this server and its backups on demand. Shared application caches are excluded; live scans reflect the files observed during the scan.
storageExcluded: Skipped links, unavailable or changing entries
playerDataHelp: Identities come from local server files or logs. Observed time covers sessions tracked by MineDock; Minecraft time comes from saved game ticks. Ping remains unavailable when the server does not report it.
playerActionConfirm: Confirm sending this moderation command. Refresh the lists or console to check its result.
runtimeMaintenanceHelp: Check the executable’s version and architecture. Stop affected servers before repair or deletion.
runtimeRepairHelp: Download a verified runtime into a staging folder and replace the existing installation atomically. Its servers must remain stopped until the operation finishes.
runtimeDeleteHelp: Delete a managed runtime. Every server using it requires an explicitly selected, healthy and compatible replacement. System runtimes remain managed by your operating system.
pocketmineSupport: PocketMine-MP has ended upstream support. Published releases may not accept current Minecraft Bedrock clients.
recoveryHelp: Stop affected servers, examine the copies, then choose the original copy or a verified backup. Type the operation label to confirm a restore.
recoveryPreserved: Copies set aside during manual recovery are preserved. Their paths remain in the operation history.
retentionHelp: Choose which automatic backups to retain. Manual and safety backups are protected by default. Review the verified archive count and space before confirming each purge. The latest eligible backup is always kept.
retentionGfsHelp: Keeps the newest archive in each of the most recent existing calendar groups. Daily, weekly and monthly groups use the selected timezone; hours follow elapsed time across daylight-saving changes.
retentionIncludeManual: Also include manual and safety backups
retentionManualWarning: This option allows deletion of manual and safety backups. Every purge requires the extra phrase shown below.
appUpdatesHelp: Stable application updates require a verified publisher signature and a matching installer checksum. Minecraft servers are never updated by this action.
updateKeyMissing: No trusted publisher update key is configured.
packagedUpdateRequired: Application update installation is available in packaged builds.
installAppUpdateHelp: Stop every server and finish active operations first. Type the application and version shown below to confirm.
systemUpdateInstallerHelp: The operating system package installer opens. Complete its installation, close MineDock and open the new version.
restartUpdateHelp: MineDock closes for installation. Complete the Windows installer if shown; portable, AppImage and writable macOS bundles restart after replacement. The previous copy is preserved during direct replacement.
engineStepHelp: Choose an edition and engine, then name your server.
resourceStepHelp: Start with a preset. MineDock installs the required runtime.
configStepHelp: Choose how you want to play. These settings can be changed later.
reviewStepHelp: Check the settings before downloading and creating your server.
engineVanilla: Original Minecraft, without mods or plugins.
enginePaper: A fast Java server with plugins. A good place to start.
enginePurpur: Paper plugins with more gameplay settings.
engineFabric: A lightweight loader for Fabric mods.
engineForge: For mods and modpacks built for Forge.
engineNeoForge: For mods and modpacks built for NeoForge.
engineBedrock: Official Bedrock server for Windows and Linux x64.
enginePocketmine: PHP-based Bedrock server with its own plugins. Support has ended.
memoryWarning: Leave memory for your operating system and Minecraft client. This preset exceeds currently available RAM.
portInUse: This port is already assigned to another MineDock server. Choose a different port.
modReviewHelp: Required dependencies install together. Optional mods are listed for information and will not be installed.
modCollectionFallback: A compatible version was selected instead of the saved version
modCollectionHelp: Save the selected mods, or all installed mods when nothing is selected. Compatible versions are checked on each destination server.
modPrereleaseWarning: Beta and alpha versions may be unstable. Only versions matching this server are shown.
modRollbackHelp: The current file is archived before restoring the selected compatible version.
modRemovalHelp: Shared dependencies are kept. You may also remove automatic dependencies that no remaining mod uses.
modBackupHelp: A server backup is created before changes. File changes are applied together or rolled back on failure.
modMigrationHelp: Analyze all mods before changing the server. Resolve manual and incompatible mods first. A backup protects the world and configuration.
modNotIdentified: No exact compatible Modrinth match; this file remains local.
pack.worldHelp: Packs apply to the selected world. Stop the server before changing files.
pack.urlHelp: Clients download the selected pack from its HTTP(S) URL. A local ZIP needs a public download URL.
pack.manualHelp: Manual packs are visible here. Manage their files in Files; automatic updates never replace them.
pack.backupHelp: MineDock creates a safety backup before changing packs.
health.title: Server health
health.memoryHelp: Memory measures the process working set, not JVM heap.
health.evidenceHelp: Suggestions use matching log evidence. Review the report before disabling content.
player.notesHelp: Notes stay in this local MineDock profile.
player.sessionsHelp: Observed sessions only; the latest 200 are shown. Closed sessions are kept for up to 180 days, capped at 20,000 per server.
player.whitelistHelp: Start the server to change the whitelist or moderate players.
snapshot.title: Incremental snapshots
snapshot.help: Stop the server first. Unchanged files share verified objects; full ZIP backups remain available.
snapshot.nasHelp: Choose a mounted NAS, network share or USB folder in Settings. Storage must remain connected during backup and restore.
snapshot.restoreHelp: The paths below will be replaced exactly. A full safety backup is created first. The first 1,000 snapshot paths are shown.
migration.title: Server evolution
migration.help: Analyze a Minecraft update or switch between Paper and Purpur. Stop the server before reviewing a change.
migration.worldHelp: World upgrades cannot be guaranteed in advance. Downgrades are blocked. Unknown/incompatible content must be resolved; the configured safety backup runs before installation.
migration.newWorld: New survival with the same content
migration.cloneHelp: A new profile and separate ports are created. The original server is preserved. New survival copies datapacks and configuration while removing world data.
console.macroHelp: Macros run in Operations and can be cancelled there. Custom macros support at most 20 steps and ten minutes of waiting.
console.truncated: Results limited to 500 lines / 16 MB / 40 plain or gzip log files.
performance.title: Measured tick performance
performance.tickHelp: TPS/MSPT are sampled from recognized Paper/Purpur command replies. Unsupported values stay unavailable; gaps are not zero.
performance.ramHelp: Suggestions keep memory for the operating system and other apps. Confirm allocations before saving. Values below are in MiB.
performance.jvmHelp: Standard keeps Java defaults. G1 aims for shorter pauses on Java 17+. Custom flags use a limited allowlist; no agents, shell arguments or memory overrides. No preset guarantees better performance.
config.title: Advanced configuration
config.help: Edit existing Paper/Purpur YAML and Fabric JSON settings. Search by key; keep the text editor for complex lists. Stop the server before editing.
config.noFiles: Start the server once to generate its configuration files.
config.historyHelp: Encrypted local history: up to 10 versions per file, 200 per server, 20 MB and 90 days.
config.auditHelp: Read-only advice. Local bind and settings do not prove Internet access.
config.restoreHelp: The current file is saved before restoring this version.
config.audit.offlineIdentity: Online identity checks are disabled: someone could use another player’s name.
config.audit.publicBind: The game listens on network interfaces. Review router forwarding and firewall rules.
config.audit.whitelistOff: Whitelist is disabled. Enable it for a private friends server.
config.audit.rconEnabled: RCON is enabled. Keep its port private; MineDock uses it for commands.
config.audit.rconMissing: RCON is enabled without a password. Stop and fix this configuration.
config.audit.permissionsOpen: The server directory is writable by other local users. Review permissions.
config.audit.permissionsUnknown: Windows access permissions require checking the folder’s Security tab.
config.simulationHelp: Simulation distance controls how far around players the world keeps ticking. Higher values use more CPU.
map.title: Server map
map.help: Install a compatible Modrinth plugin after review. Its webserver will bind to this computer only. Start/restart and wait for rendering; Internet exposure is not configured.
map.assets: Allow BlueMap to download additional Mojang assets
reach.title: Test Internet access
reach.help: A local connection only checks this PC. An external Minecraft status observer checks the public address you enter; its answer may be cached.
reach.consent: I agree to send this address and game port to mcstatus.io for this test. The service also sees my request IP.
reach.firewall: Firewall rules and router forwarding are not automatically inspected or changed. UDP local reachability stays unknown.
package.title: Move to another PC
package.help: A .minedock package contains worlds, content and profile settings. Java and engine binaries are installed for the destination PC. Default exports omit arbitrary mod/plugin configs and reset the resource pack URL; set it again after importing. Player lists and world data are included.
package.sensitive: Include mod/plugin configurations; I understand they can contain secrets and private settings.
package.trust: Import packages only from people you trust. Mods/plugins execute code. Import copies data, selects free ports and adjusts RAM; the original package stays unchanged. An Internet connection is required to install the engine/runtime.
package.containsSensitive: This package explicitly includes configurations that may contain secrets. Keep it private.
package.accept: I reviewed this package and accept the Minecraft EULA where applicable (minecraft.net/eula).
health.port: Game port is already in use
health.minecraftUpdate: A newer Minecraft release is available
pack.updateHelp: Check compatible Modrinth releases on demand. Offline or local packs keep an unknown compatibility status. Required dependencies are reviewed before any update.
modArchived: This project is archived on Modrinth. Review its maintenance status before installing.
catalog.showAll: Show all available builds / loader versions
catalog.experimental: This older or experimental version is not marked stable upstream. Review compatibility before installing.
catalog.review: Review your version choices: a selected version is unavailable or incompatible.
catalog.offline: Offline: showing the last saved official catalog. Availability will be checked before installation.
property.editorHelp: Real engine settings. Changes apply on the next start; existing files and unknown keys are preserved.
property.stopFirst: Stop the server before editing. Saved settings apply on its next start.
property.unknown: Existing custom key; its meaning is controlled by the engine or mod.
property.secretHelp: RCON passwords are managed securely by MineDock and are never shown here. Disabling RCON prevents live backups and RCON commands.
property.packHelp: The Resource packs tab manages local ZIPs, published URLs and their hashes. Edit these fields only when configuring an external pack.
property.noFields: No applicable settings in this category.
property.saveHelp: A full safety backup and encrypted configuration history are saved first. Only changed properties are written.
property.acceptRisks: I have reviewed these changes and their effects.
property.risk.identity: Turning online mode off removes account verification. Review access and whitelist before changing it.
property.risk.world: A new name may select a different world folder. Seeds and generation options affect newly generated terrain, not existing chunks.
property.risk.network: Port or bind changes affect who can connect. Keep game, query and RCON ports separate and review your firewall.
property.risk.rcon: RCON grants server administration. Keep it private; changing or disabling it affects MineDock live operations.
profile.title: Server profile
profile.help: This display name and local image belong to MineDock. They do not rename the world or change Java MOTD.
property.help.general: Shown to players or used when they join.
property.help.world: Controls world selection, generation or simulation.
property.help.network: Connection settings; keep administrative services private.
property.help.resources: Advanced performance setting; review before changing.
property.leaveHelp: Leave this page and discard your unsaved changes?
property.invalid: Check the highlighted values, ranges, URL or JSON format before saving.
config.curatedHelp: Common Paper settings are shown only when present in this version’s configuration. Use the file editor for complex YAML.
